A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] was a [[Shaman/Legends|'''shaman''']] in her clan, being a notable exception from other females, who were shown little respect in Jawa society.

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Jawa Shaman" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artist [[Mark Poole]].
